card.architecture: Grayscale morphological erosion / min filter (no model) — LineThicken node (ComfyUI-PixelHarness)
card.summary: Boldens outlines by growing dark pixels with a per-channel 3x3 min filter (the cv2.erode / ImageMagick Erode / Photoshop Minimum algorithm). No model, no VRAM. Thickens every dark pixel (interior detail included).
card.pick_when: You want a fast, deterministic outline thicken and don't mind interior lines thickening too.
